app.name: Bonfire
app.tagline: Game save backup with version history
cli.cmd.root: Bonfire: game save backup with version history
cli.cmd.game.add: Add a game manually (save folder or file)
cli.cmd.game.rm: Remove a game: manual games are deleted, discovered ones are ignored (snapshots stay)
cli.cmd.scan: Discover games and saves on Steam/Epic/GOG (nothing is added automatically) and detect changes of managed games
cli.cmd.status: Show game status; lists changed files for one game
cli.cmd.diff: Compare two snapshots, or a snapshot with the disk
cli.cmd.branch: Create or delete a branch; lists branches and tags without a name
cli.cmd.tag: Create or delete a tag (tags are never cleaned up); lists without a name
cli.cmd.reindex: Rebuild the index database from the repository
cli.arg.game.add.name: Game name
cli.arg.game.add.install_dir: Install folder, used to detect a running game
cli.arg.scan.force_verify: Ignore metadata and rehash every file
cli.arg.status.force_verify: Ignore metadata and rehash every file
cli.arg.backup.message: Snapshot comment (max 500 chars); generated when omitted
cli.arg.backup.profile: Use the games of a profile
cli.arg.backup.force: Create a snapshot even without changes
cli.arg.backup.all: Back up every game that changed or was never backed up
cli.arg.backup.new_branch: Name of the new branch after restoring an old snapshot
cli.arg.backup.move_branch: Move the current branch instead of creating one after a restore
cli.arg.diff.b: Snapshot B; compares with the disk when omitted
cli.arg.restore.target: Snapshot to restore (HEAD~1, tag, branch, hash prefix)
cli.arg.restore.full: Full restore: also delete files not in the snapshot
cli.arg.restore.force: Restore even if the game is running
cli.arg.ref.name: Name; lists when omitted
cli.arg.profile.name: Profile name
cli.arg.fsck.deep: Rebuild every file and verify its hash (slower)
cli.out.no_games: No games yet. Add one with: bonfire game add <name> --path <save folder>
cli.out.game_removed: Removed "{name}"; its snapshots stay in the repository
cli.out.restore_plan: Will overwrite {overwrite}, create {create}, delete {delete} files; {unchanged} identical
cli.out.protection: Created protection snapshot {id}; undo with bonfire undo-restore
cli.out.fsck_ok: Repository OK: {chunks} chunks, {blobs} files, {trees} trees, {snapshots} snapshots, {refs} refs
cli.out.fsck_tmp: {n} temporary files left by interrupted writes
cli.error.need_yes: Pass --yes to confirm in a non-interactive session
cli.cmd.game.confirm: Confirm heuristically found save locations (saved as a custom rule)
cli.arg.scan.platform: Only scan one platform: steam / epic / gog
cli.arg.scan.no_discover: Skip platform discovery, only detect changes
cli.arg.rules.update.bundle: Also write a bundled snapshot (for packaging)
cli.out.discovered: Platforms: {platforms}; {found} games with saves: {new} new, {managed} in library, {ignored} ignored; {nosave} installed games without saves
cli.out.no_rules: No rules downloaded yet; run bonfire rules update
cli.out.game_ignored: Ignored "{name}"; it won't show as new again. Re-add with bonfire game include
cli.cmd.info: Show or edit game info (name, cover, developer, playtime…)
cli.arg.info.set: Edit and lock a field: name / nameZh / developer / publisher / releaseDate / cover (image path)
cli.arg.info.unlock: Unlock a field for automatic refresh
cli.arg.info.search: Search candidates by name (needs an IGDB or SteamGridDB key)
cli.out.no_candidates: No candidates (set an IGDB or SteamGridDB API key)
cli.out.no_metadata: No info yet; run a scan or bonfire info <game> --refresh
ui.configError: The config file has errors; started with defaults: {msg}
ui.nav.label: Main navigation
ui.library.emptyBody: Scan Steam, Epic and GOG on the Discover page and pick the games to manage. Add emulators or indie games by hand.
ui.backup.title: Back up selected games
ui.backup.subtitle: Write a comment for each game, or leave it empty to describe the changes automatically.
ui.backup.commentPlaceholder: For example: before the final boss
ui.backup.detachedIntro: {names} continued from an older snapshot. For this backup:
ui.backup.detachedNew: Start a new branch and keep the original line (recommended)
ui.backup.detachedMove: Continue the current branch; its later snapshots are kept for 30 days
ui.add.title: Add a game
ui.add.subtitle: For emulators, indie games and others the scan can't find.
ui.add.name: Game name
ui.add.installHint: With an install folder, restores check whether the game is running.
ui.history.restoredFrom: Restored snapshot {id}. You can undo until the next backup.
ui.history.emptyBody: Select this game in the library and back it up to light the first bonfire.
ui.history.pick: Pick a snapshot on the timeline
ui.history.confirmed: Confirmed; backups now include these locations
ui.history.removeConfirm: Remove "{name}"? Its snapshots stay in the repository.
ui.history.pickHint: Select files to restore only some of them, such as one save slot.
ui.restore.title: Restore snapshot {id}
ui.restore.subtitle: Close the game before restoring.
ui.restore.partial: Only the {n} selected files are restored.
ui.restore.full: Full restore (delete files not in the snapshot)
ui.restore.protection: Current saves have unsaved changes. A protection snapshot is taken before restoring.
ui.restore.cloud: This game uses platform cloud saves. When the game starts, choose to keep the local save, or the cloud may overwrite it.
ui.restore.runningList: The game is running: {p}. It may overwrite the restored files.
ui.restore.running: The game is running. Close it first.
ui.restore.nothing: Current saves already match this snapshot.
ui.restore.doneProtected: Restored. Previous saves are kept in snapshot {id}
ui.settings.repoHint: All snapshots live here. A non-system drive or a synced cloud folder works well. Changing it doesn't move the existing repository.
ui.settings.includeConfigHint: Include game settings such as graphics and key bindings
ui.settings.onlineHint: Fetches names, covers and developers. Only game IDs or names are sent, never your saves.
ui.settings.keysHint: IGDB and SteamGridDB need your own API keys. They're optional; without them only Steam data is used.
ui.settings.rulesInfo: Using the community rules: {games} games, {user} custom rules.
ui.settings.rulesMissing: No rules yet; only custom rules and guesses are used.
ui.settings.fsckOk: Repository OK: {snapshots} snapshots and {files} files restore intact.
ui.wizard.repoBody: The repository grows as you back up. Unchanged files never take extra space.
ui.wizard.platformsBody: Bonfire only reads install info and saves from these platforms; it never changes them.
ui.wizard.summaryHint: You can change all of this later in Settings. When you finish, Bonfire scans your games so you can pick which ones to manage.
ui.backup.upToDate: No changes; no new snapshot will be made
ui.scan.title: Discover games
ui.scan.introBody: Scanning reads install info from Steam, Epic and GOG and locates each game's saves with the community rules. It only reads files. You decide which games to manage.
ui.scan.ignored: Ignored {n} games; they won't show as new again
ui.scan.noPlatforms: No Steam, Epic or GOG found. You can add games by hand in the library.
ui.scan.noRules: No save rules yet (maybe offline), so only guesses are shown. Update the rules in Settings when online.
ui.scan.noSaveYet: No saves on this PC yet
ui.scan.withoutSavesHint: Unplayed games have no saves. For games missing from the rules, add the save folder by hand in the library.
cli.cmd.game.include: Add discovered games to the library
cli.cmd.game.ignore: Ignore discovered games (managed ones leave the library; snapshots stay)
cli.out.include_hint: Add games with: bonfire game include <game>..., or bonfire game include --all-new
cli.cmd.export: Export save files (current or a snapshot) as a zip or folder
cli.arg.export.snapshot: Snapshot to export (branch, tag or ID); omit for the current saves on disk
cli.arg.export.folder: Create the export folder inside this directory
cli.cmd.import: Import save files (zip or folder) as a new snapshot; never writes to the save folder
cli.arg.import.source: Zip file or folder (ideally made by bonfire export)
cli.arg.import.parent: Snapshot the new branch starts from; omit for an independent start
cli.arg.import.onto: Append to this branch (moves it) instead of creating a branch
cli.cmd.bundle: History bundles: export or import saves with branch history (.bonfire)
cli.cmd.bundle.export: Export a bundle: all branches by default, or chosen branches or a range; several games or --all make a collection
cli.cmd.bundle.import: Import a bundle or collection: compares by snapshot ID, never overwrites local branches or save folders; games missing from the library are added (not installed)
cli.arg.bundle.import.game: Local game to import into (needed for custom games whose ID differs)
cli.out.import_identical: Same content as snapshot {id}; nothing imported
cli.out.import_hint: Save folders are untouched; use bonfire restore to switch to it (current saves are protected first)
cli.out.bundle_partial: Partial history: the importer needs {n} earlier snapshots
cli.bundle.diverged: diverged from local at {fork}; imported as {name}
cli.out.bundle_locations: Note: the bundle's save locations differ from yours; check the preview before restoring
cli.out.bundle_imported: Imported {n} snapshots; your current snapshot and save folders are unchanged
ui.scan.pickVisible: Select or clear all listed games
ui.history.goBranch: Go to the latest snapshot on {name}
ui.history.unconfirmedNote: {n} guessed save locations need confirming before they are backed up (see More actions)
ui.transfer.filesHint: Save files from one point in time. Usable directly, or importable into Bonfire.
ui.transfer.bundleHint: A .bonfire file with snapshots and branches, to import on another PC or for a friend.
ui.transfer.pickOnGraph: Pick the snapshot in the graph.
ui.transfer.rangeHint: Click the last snapshot, then an earlier one as the start. Without a start, the range begins at the first snapshot.
ui.transfer.pickParent: Choose where to create the export folder
ui.transfer.importSafe: Importing only adds to the history; your save files are not touched. Restore the imported snapshot to use it.
ui.transfer.importIntro: A bundle is matched by snapshot: later progress on the same history continues your branch, diverged progress becomes a new branch, nothing is overwritten. Plain save files become a new snapshot.
ui.transfer.placeIndependent: New branch, independent start (for someone else's saves)
ui.transfer.placeForkHint: Pick the snapshot in the graph:
ui.transfer.placeContinue: Continue a branch (as its next update)
ui.transfer.graphForkHint: Click a snapshot to branch the import from it.
ui.transfer.missing: This bundle is a partial history and {n} earlier snapshots are missing. Import the earlier part first.
ui.transfer.locationMismatch: The bundle's save locations differ from yours. Check the preview before restoring.
ui.transfer.action.fast-forward: Continues your branch; it moves forward
ui.transfer.action.diverged: Diverged from yours at {fork}; imported as {name}, yours is kept
ui.transfer.action.tag-conflict: Your tag with this name points elsewhere; skipped
ui.transfer.unmappedHint: {n} files don't match a save location. Keep one folder per save location, as exported.
ui.transfer.identical: These saves are identical to snapshot {id}, so there is nothing to import. The graph on the right is scrolled to it and marked “Same”.
ui.history.graphHint: Each colored line is a branch; a fork is new progress played after restoring an older snapshot. Click a snapshot for details.
ui.scan.noneNewBody: Every game found is already in the library or ignored.
cli.arg.branch.delete: Delete this branch along with the snapshots only it reaches
cli.arg.branch.dry_run: Only preview which snapshots would be deleted
cli.cmd.rm: Delete a snapshot: later snapshots are re-attached to its parent; tagged snapshots are protected
cli.arg.bundle.export.games: Game IDs or names; several games are exported as a collection
cli.arg.bundle.export.all: Export every game in the library (collection)
cli.arg.bundle.import.only: Only import these games from a collection (ID or name, repeatable)
cli.out.branch_deleted: Deleted branch {name} and the {n} snapshots only it reached
cli.out.branch_emptied: Branch {name} had no snapshots left and was deleted
cli.out.snapshot_deleted: Deleted snapshot {id}; {n} later snapshots were re-attached to its parent
cli.confirm.delete_branch: Delete branch {name} and the {n} snapshots only it reaches? This cannot be undone
cli.confirm.delete_snapshot: Delete snapshot {id} ({n} later snapshots will be re-attached to its parent)? This cannot be undone
cli.error.collection_scope: Several games can only be exported with all branches; --branch / --from / --to are not allowed
cli.out.bundle_new_game: "{game}" was not in the library and has been added (not installed: install and scan it to restore)
ui.library.checkedNone: Check finished: no new changes in {total} games
ui.library.notInstalledHint: Imported from elsewhere and not installed on this PC; install it and scan on the Discover page to back up and restore as usual
ui.collection.exportIntro: Pack every snapshot and branch of the chosen games into one .bonfire file. Import it in Bonfire on another PC to bring the whole backup history along.
ui.collection.importIntro: Games missing from the library are added and marked “Not installed”. Importing only adds backup history and never touches save files.
ui.collection.chooseArchiveHint: A .bonfire file exported by Bonfire, may hold several games
ui.collection.chooseZipHint: A save zip exported by Bonfire and shared with you
ui.collection.stateNew: Not in library, will be added (not installed)
ui.collection.filesNewGame: This game is not in your library. It will be added as “Not installed” with the saves on branch main.
ui.collection.filesExisting: The saves become a new snapshot on a new branch; your branches stay as they are.
ui.history.deleteTagged: Tagged snapshots are protected; delete the tag first
ui.history.deleteRewire: The {n} later snapshots will be attached to its parent; their contents stay the same.
ui.history.deleteBranchGone: Branch {names} has only this snapshot and will be deleted too.
ui.history.deleteHeadSwitch: The current branch will switch to {name}.
ui.history.deleteHereNote: This snapshot matches your current saves; after deleting it the game shows “Changed” and can be backed up again.
ui.history.deleteFinal: This cannot be undone; the space is freed by a later repository cleanup.
ui.history.deleteBranchConfirm: Delete branch “{name}”? The {n} snapshots only this branch reaches are deleted too; snapshots shared with other branches stay.
ui.history.deleteTagConfirm: Delete tag “{name}”? Only the tag is removed; the snapshot stays.
ui.history.notInstalledNote: This game was imported and is not installed on this PC. Install it and scan on the Discover page; once its save locations are known you can restore.
ui.collection.identical: These saves are identical to snapshot {id} of “{name}”; nothing to import.
ui.settings.closeToTrayHint: When minimized to the tray, Bonfire keeps running in the background (the Bonfire icon at the bottom right) and auto backups and scheduled screenshot collection continue; quit from the tray menu.
ui.settings.protectLocalHint: Snapshots backed up on this PC ({host}), and branches containing them, cannot be deleted; imported ones are not affected
ui.settings.protectLocalOff: With protection off, this PC's snapshots and branches can be deleted, and deletion cannot be undone. Turn it off?
ui.history.protectedHint: Save protection: snapshots backed up on this PC cannot be deleted (can be turned off in Settings)
ui.library.protectTipOn: Save protection is on: snapshots and branches backed up on this PC ({host}) cannot be deleted. Click to turn off
ui.library.protectTipOff: Save protection is off: this PC's snapshots and branches can be deleted, and deletion cannot be undone. Click to turn on
ui.library.protectEnabled: Save protection on: snapshots and branches backed up on this PC ({host}) will not be deleted
ui.library.protectDisabled: Save protection off: this PC's snapshots and branches can now be deleted, and deletion cannot be undone
cli.cmd.shots: Screenshot albums: list, collect, export and delete game screenshots (kept apart from save snapshots)
cli.cmd.shots.sync: Collect new screenshots (all games when none given; also runs on every backup)
cli.cmd.shots.export: Export screenshots as a zip or folder (all by default)
cli.cmd.shots.rm: Move screenshots to the recycle bin (undo with shots restore); --purge deletes them for good. Only the backup is touched, never the originals on disk
cli.cmd.shots.set: Choose whether to collect screenshots for this game
cli.arg.shots.export.out_file: Zip file to write; with --folder, the directory to create a folder in
cli.arg.shots.export.folder: Export to a folder instead of a zip
cli.arg.shots.export.since: Only screenshots taken on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)
cli.arg.shots.export.snapshot: Only screenshots taken before this snapshot (it is the first snapshot after them)
cli.arg.shots.rm.ids: Screenshot IDs to delete (prefix of at least 6 characters)
cli.arg.shots.set.value: on / off / auto (follow the global setting)
cli.cmd.game.shots-dir: Add or remove a screenshot folder for a game (in-game screenshots, other tools)
cli.cmd.game.shots-dir.rm: Remove a screenshot folder (collected screenshots stay)
cli.out.shots_summary: {game}: {n} screenshots backed up, {size}; {pending} new on disk
cli.out.shots_disabled: Screenshot backup is off for this game (turn on with bonfire shots set <game> on)
cli.out.shots_synced: Collected {n} new screenshots; screenshot folders were only read
cli.confirm.shots_rm: Move {n} screenshots of "{game}" to the recycle bin? Undo with bonfire shots restore; the originals on disk are not touched
cli.out.shots_deleted: Moved {n} screenshots to the recycle bin
cli.out.shots_off: Screenshots of "{game}" will not be collected
cli.out.shots_dir_removed: Removed screenshot folder {dir} from "{game}" (collected screenshots stay)
ui.shots.title: Screenshot album
ui.shots.pending: {n} new screenshots on disk are not collected yet
ui.shots.disabledNote: Screenshots are not collected for this game; existing backups stay.
ui.shots.noSource: No screenshot source found for this game. For in-game screenshots or other tools (NVIDIA, Epic…), add their folder.
ui.shots.dirsHint: Read only; removing a folder keeps the screenshots already collected.
ui.shots.emptyBody: Take screenshots with F12 (Steam) or Win+Alt+PrtSc (Game Bar); they are collected with your next backup, or click “Collect new screenshots”.
ui.shots.noSaveYet: No save backed up after it yet
ui.settings.shotsEnabledHint: Steam screenshots, Windows Game Bar captures and folders you add; screenshots form a separate album and never enter save snapshots. Each game can opt out on its page.
ui.settings.capturesDirHint: Leave empty to use the system Captures folder: {dir}
ui.settings.scheduleHint: Screenshots are collected with every backup; scheduled collection runs while Bonfire is running (including in the tray).
ui.settings.syncAll: Collect screenshots of all games now
cli.arg.bundle.export.shots: Also export the screenshot album (off by default)
cli.arg.backup.auto: Automatic backup: back up every game that changed and has been backed up before, and collect screenshots (same as the desktop app's scheduled backup; for system task schedulers)
cli.out.backup_shots_only: {game}: screenshots only, saves are not backed up
cli.out.auto_done: Automatic backup finished: {n} games got a new snapshot
cli.arg.shots.rm.purge: Delete for good (cannot be undone; the originals on disk won't be collected again)
cli.cmd.shots.restore: Restore screenshots from the recycle bin
cli.arg.shots.restore.ids: Screenshot IDs to restore (prefix of at least 6 characters)
cli.cmd.shots.trash: List screenshots in the recycle bin; --empty empties it
cli.arg.shots.trash.empty: Empty the recycle bin (delete its screenshots for good)
cli.cmd.shots.found: List games that have screenshots but are not in the library (add them with game add-shots)
cli.confirm.shots_purge: Delete {n} screenshots of "{game}" for good? This cannot be undone; the originals on disk are not touched and won't be collected again
cli.confirm.shots_empty_trash: Empty the recycle bin of "{game}" ({n} screenshots)? This cannot be undone
cli.out.shots_trash: {game}: {n} screenshots in the recycle bin, {size} in total
cli.out.shots_found_none: No screenshots of games outside the library were found
cli.out.shots_only_game: "{game}" manages screenshots only; saves are not backed up
cli.out.shots_where: Originals are kept in {dir} ({trash} more in the recycle bin)
cli.cmd.game.add-shots: Add a screenshots-only game (saves are not backed up): Game Bar captures match by name; use --steam for a Steam AppID
cli.arg.game.add-shots.name: Game name (matched against the title in Game Bar capture file names)
cli.arg.game.add-shots.steam: Steam AppID (collect Steam screenshots for it)
cli.cmd.game.shots-only: Manage screenshots only (on) or manage saves again (off)
cli.arg.game.shots-only.value: on: screenshots only / off: also manage saves
cli.out.shots_only_on: "{game}" now manages screenshots only: saves are no longer backed up or checked; existing snapshots are kept
ui.auto.doneChange: Saves changed and were backed up: {names} ({n} games)
ui.backup.allUpToDate: All {n} selected games are up to date; nothing to back up.
ui.backup.skippedTitle: Up to date, will be skipped ({n})
ui.backup.skippedHint: These saves haven't changed since the last backup, so no new snapshot is made.
ui.history.bigGraphHint: See the whole branch graph full screen; double-click a snapshot to open it.
ui.history.shotsOnlyHint: Stop backing up and checking saves, collect screenshots only; existing snapshots are kept
ui.history.manageSavesHint: Back up and check this game's saves again
ui.history.shotsOnlyNote: This game manages screenshots only and its saves are not backed up. To back up saves, click "Screenshots only" above and choose "Saves & screenshots".
ui.shots.storedHint: Backed-up originals are kept in this folder, uncompressed at full quality. The grid shows thumbnails; open one to see the original.
ui.shots.trashHint: Screenshots in the recycle bin still take {size} and can be restored. Note: screenshots in the recycle bin or deleted for good are never collected again, even if the originals are still on disk; use "Compare with disk" to collect them again.
ui.shots.trashEmptyBody: Screenshots you delete from the album go here first and can be restored.
ui.shots.trashed: Moved {n} screenshots to the recycle bin; they won't be collected again (the originals on disk are not touched)
ui.shots.purgeConfirm: Delete {n} screenshots for good? This cannot be undone; the originals on disk are not touched and won't be collected again.
ui.shots.emptyTrashConfirm: Empty the recycle bin ({n} screenshots)? This cannot be undone; the originals on disk are not touched and won't be collected again.
ui.shots.revealHint: Show the backed-up original in File Explorer
ui.settings.autoChangeHint: Check saves regularly and back up once a change is found and the game has stopped writing (like backing up right after the game saves).
ui.settings.autoHint: Runs while Bonfire is running (including in the tray). Only games that changed and were backed up manually at least once are backed up; new screenshots are collected too. Snapshots made this way are labeled "Scheduled" / "Auto" in the branch graph.
ui.add.shotsSubtitle: Collect this game's screenshots only; saves are not backed up.
ui.add.shotsHint: Game Bar captures are matched by the title at the start of the file name, so use the same name; for in-game or other tools' screenshots, add their folder.
ui.scan.shotFinds: Games with screenshots that aren't in the library ({n})
ui.scan.shotFindsHint: Found in Steam screenshots and Windows Game Bar captures. Add them as screenshots-only games: screenshots are collected, saves are not backed up. You can switch to managing saves later in the game's details.
cli.cmd.game.mode: Show or change how a game is managed: both (saves and screenshots) / saves (saves only) / shots (screenshots only)
cli.arg.game.mode.mode: New mode; omit to show the current one
cli.cmd.shots.diff: Compare the screenshot backup with the screenshot folders on disk: new, ignored (recycle bin / deleted for good) and missing on disk
cli.cmd.shots.write-back: Write screenshots that are backed up but missing on disk back to where they were (or to --to); only creates missing files, never overwrites
cli.arg.shots.write-back.ids: Only these screenshots (ID prefix, at least 6 characters); omit for all missing ones
cli.arg.shots.write-back.to: Write into this folder instead of the original location
cli.cmd.shots.recollect: Collect ignored screenshots again: restore those in the recycle bin, re-collect those deleted for good
cli.out.shots_diff: "{game}": {synced} in both; {new} new on disk ({dup} more have the same content as collected ones); ignored: {trash} in the recycle bin, {purged} deleted for good; {missing} missing on disk ({restorable} can be written back)
cli.out.shots_nothing_missing: All backed-up screenshots are still on disk; nothing to write back
cli.confirm.shots_write_back: Write {n} screenshots of "{game}" to {place}? Only missing files are created; nothing is overwritten
cli.out.shots_written: Wrote {n} screenshots ({size}); skipped {exists} (a file with that name exists) and {nodir} (the folder no longer exists)
ui.mode.title: Manage
ui.mode.bothHint: Back up saves and collect screenshots
ui.mode.savesHint: Back up saves only, don't collect screenshots; collected ones are kept
ui.mode.shotsHint: Collect screenshots only and stop backing up or checking saves; existing snapshots are kept and save files on disk are not touched. You can switch back any time
ui.mode.switchHint: How {name} is managed; click to change
ui.mode.filter: Filter by how games are managed
ui.auto.quick.tip: Auto backup: quickly set scheduled backups and backup on save change
ui.close.title: When you close the window
ui.close.subtitle: This is the first time you're closing Bonfire. Choose what closing the window should do.
ui.close.trayBody: Bonfire stays at the bottom right of the taskbar and auto backups and scheduled screenshot collection keep running; quit from the tray menu.
ui.close.exitBody: Exit the program. Auto backups and scheduled screenshot collection won't run until you open Bonfire again.
ui.close.remember: Remember my choice and don't ask again (change it in Settings > When closing the window)
ui.gallery.emptyTrashConfirm: Empty the recycle bin of all games ({n} screenshots)? This cannot be undone; the originals on disk are not touched and won't be collected again.
ui.gallery.emptyBody: Steam and Windows Game Bar screenshots are collected when you back up a game. Games with screenshots only can be added on the Discover page.
ui.diff.buttonHint: Compare backed-up screenshots with the folders on disk: new, ignored and missing ones
ui.diff.title: Screenshots vs. disk · {name}
ui.diff.subtitle: Backed-up screenshots compared with the screenshot folders on disk (Steam, Game Bar and folders you added).
ui.diff.syncedBody: Collected, and the originals are still on disk.
ui.diff.newBodyDup: Not collected yet. {n} more have the same content as collected ones (renamed or moved) and won't be collected twice.
ui.diff.ignoredBody: The originals are still on disk, but {trash} are in the recycle bin and {purged} were deleted for good, so they won't be collected again or shown as new.
ui.diff.missingBody: Backed up but gone from their original location (maybe deleted in the game or Steam). {n} of them can be written back because the folder still exists.
ui.diff.missingNone: All backed-up screenshots are still on disk.
ui.diff.writeBackHint: Copy the originals back to their folders; only missing files are created, nothing is overwritten
ui.diff.writeBackConfirm: Write {n} screenshots back to their folders? Only missing files are created and nothing is overwritten. Images written to Steam's screenshot folder won't show up in Steam's screenshot manager automatically.
ui.diff.pickFolder: Choose a folder for the screenshots
ui.diff.writtenSkipped: ; skipped {exists} (a file with that name exists) and {nodir} (the folder no longer exists)
cli.arg.shots.rm.delete_originals: Also delete the originals on disk (moved to the system recycle bin; only files identical to the backup); requires --purge
cli.arg.shots.trash.delete_originals: When emptying the recycle bin, also delete the originals on disk (moved to the system recycle bin; only files identical to the backup)
cli.confirm.shots_delete_originals: . The originals on disk will also be moved to the system recycle bin
cli.out.shots_originals: Originals on disk: {n} moved to the system recycle bin, {kept} kept because they changed, {failed} failed
ui.purge.title: Delete screenshots for good
ui.purge.originals: Also delete the originals on disk
ui.purge.originalsOff: Unchecked: the originals in Steam, Game Bar and other folders stay untouched (and won't be collected again).
ui.purge.originalsOn: The originals are moved to the Windows recycle bin, where you can restore them; only files identical to the backup are deleted, changed ones are kept.
ui.purge.originalsDone: ; originals on disk: {n} moved to the system recycle bin, {kept} kept because they changed, {failed} failed
